sentences: Traders moved $546 million through Polymarket in the week of 2026-05-11, across 23.8 million individual trades. Algorithmic wallets accounted for 73% of weekly counterparty events (both maker and taker sides counted); everyone else split the remaining 27%.

The usual pattern held: algorithmic traders made $80K (+69 bps on volume) while retail traders lost $83K (-432 bps).
